content_zh:
“张扬，不可以。”
“夏薇，求你了，给我。”
“滚开……”
东珠大酒店，一千五百块一晚的豪华房间之内，张扬从床上跌落。
将他踢落床的是他的女朋友夏薇，两人交往了两年多。
张扬在她身上花光了所有积蓄，可至今都没能突破最后一步，刚刚还被一脚踢下床。
“张扬，你自己搭车回去。”夏薇用被子挡住身体，冷冷道。
“为什么？”
“我还是第一次，万一你兽性大发，半夜把我强了怎么办？”夏薇将床头的衣服砸给他，凶巴巴地命令，“快滚。”
张扬无力地穿起衣服，突然，脑海中传出一道声音：“真他妈的废物，你真是枉为男人。”
谁？
张扬左顾右盼，并没有看到人。
“我乃合欢老祖，是前晚那一道流光。”
前夜，张扬正在野外看星星，一道流光突然从天而降，进入他的身体。
他害怕极了，过了两天，身体没什么反应，他才把这件事情给忘记了。
“合欢老祖是什么鬼？”张扬奇怪地问。
“我灵魂受到重创，先传你一门修炼功法，等你修炼一定程度，滋养了我，我就能再次苏醒过来。”
紧接，张扬感觉脑海中多出了许多记忆。
“魔道无上宗派，合欢宗太上长老。”
“强行给女帝下药，得手之后，被女帝追杀，肉身俱灭。”

“剩下一缕残魂，流落到这一界。”
消化记忆之后，张扬惊得目瞪口呆。
这合欢老祖也太牛逼了吧，连女帝都敢硬推，简直就是男人中的战斗机。
“记住，女人是工具，不是上帝。”
合欢老祖说完最后这句话，就下线了。
“还愣着干什么，还不快滚？”
见张扬还在傻站着，夏薇怒孔。
“你再骂一句试试。”
张扬一把抓住她的手，目光凶狠地盯着她。
突然，脑海中弹出一行字：非元阴体，阴气值1。
张扬惊得目瞪口呆，下一刻气急败坏。
content_en:
"Zhang Yang, no."
"Xia Wei, please, give it to me."
"Go away..."
In the Dongzhu Hotel, in a luxurious room worth 1,500 yuan a night, Zhang Yang fell from the bed.
The person who kicked him off the bed was his girlfriend Xia Wei, with whom he had been dating for more than two years.
Zhang Yang spent all his savings on her, but he still hasn't been able to break through the last step. He was kicked out of bed just now.
"Zhang Yang, take a ride back by yourself." Xia Wei covered her body with a quilt and said coldly.
"Why?"
"This is my first time. What if your bestiality comes out and you rape me in the middle of the night?" Xia Wei threw the clothes on the bed to him and ordered fiercely, "Get out of here."
Zhang Yang put on his clothes feebly, and suddenly, a voice came from his mind: "What a fucking waste, you are really unworthy of being a man."
Who?
Zhang Yang looked around and saw no one.
"I am the ancestor of Hehuan, and I am the stream of light the night before."
The night before, Zhang Yang was watching the stars in the wild when a stream of light suddenly fell from the sky and entered his body.
He was so scared that after two days, when his body showed no reaction, he forgot about it.
"What the hell is Patriarch Hehuan?" Zhang Yang asked strangely.
"My soul has been severely damaged. I will teach you a practice method first. After you practice it to a certain level and nourish me, I will wake up again."
Immediately afterwards, Zhang Yang felt that there were many more memories in his mind.
"The supreme sect of the devil, the Supreme Elder of Hehuan Sect."
"Forcibly drugged the Empress. After he succeeded, he was hunted down by the Empress and both his body and body were destroyed."
"There is only one residual soul left, wandering into this world."
After digesting the memory, Zhang Yang was stunned.
This ancestor of Hehuan is so awesome. Even the empress dares to push him hard. He is simply a fighter among men.
“Remember, women are tools, not God.”
After the Hehuan Patriarch said these last words, he went offline.
"Why are you still standing there, why don't you get out of here?"
Seeing Zhang Yang still standing there stupidly, Xia Wei scowled angrily.
"Try swearing again."
Zhang Yang grabbed her hand and stared at her fiercely.
Suddenly, a line of words popped up in his mind: non-yin body, yin energy value 1.
Zhang Yang was stunned and became furious the next moment.
